result.reason: The six-month transition assistance, then-current rates, machine-readable format, and deletion certification align with the preferred position. However, data return is required within 30 days of Corio’s written request rather than within 30 days after expiration or termination. If no prompt request is made, Commerce One has no fixed post-termination export deadline, and Section 11.3 may permit destruction in the interim. The addition is otherwise targeted, preserves the existing survival framework, and is professionally drafted.
